lock_effect: Gold appears on the boards in exactly one structural place — the urgent header rule and its count — so gold itself becomes the urgency signal fleet-wide.

mutations.change: Add the .accent-rule treatment: a gold keyline rule under the section title. Gold is a highlight only, never a background field.
Count numeral in --accent gold; the word 'urgent' stays in standard text colour beside it.
No rule, no gold: headers stay in --text on the flat ground, green reserved for identity and the primary action.

summary: The urgent section header carries the package's gold accent-rule and a gold count numeral, making the urgent block the one gold-ruled region on the board; all other section headers stay green-led and unruled.
